components.name: Button
components.description: Default control: plain stone surface with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); background: var(--surface, #fcfcfb); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(11,11,11,0.10)); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--hover, rgba(11,11,11,0.05)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #0b0b0b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Save/start action in the ink action colour.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--on-action, #fff); background: var(--action, #0b0b0b); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #0b0b0b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary[disabled] { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Header route buttons; the current route is filled.
components.html: LoopsStartConfiguration
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-navbtn { color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); background: var(--surface, #fcfcfb); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(11,11,11,0.10)); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-navbtn:hover { background: var(--hover, rgba(11,11,11,0.05)); } .ds-navbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #0b0b0b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-navbtn.ds-active { background: var(--action, #0b0b0b); color: var(--on-action, #fff); border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Config Field
components.description: Labelled config input with its source file underneath.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 3px; font: 13px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); max-width: 300px; } .ds-field input { font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); background: var(--surface, #fcfcfb); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(11,11,11,0.10)); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 8px; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #0b0b0b); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-src { color: var(--muted, #6b6a65); font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pill with a status dot; the text stays ink.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font: 12px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(11,11,11,0.10)); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: Flat metric tile: label, large value, sub-line.
components.css: .ds-tile { font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; background: var(--surface, #fcfcfb); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(11,11,11,0.10)); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; max-width: 200px; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); } .ds-label { color: var(--muted, #6b6a65); font-size: 12px; } .ds-value { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 2px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-sub { color: var(--ink-2, #52514e); font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview:
The dashboard records a conversation between two agents. Everything is built around those two voices: the coder speaks in blue, the reviewer in orange, and both appear on quiet stone-grey paper that adds nothing of its own. Charts, legends, round timelines and side-by-side document panes all keep the same voice-to-colour mapping, so a reader can follow who said what without reading a label.

The console is quiet and utilitarian. Surfaces are flat, separated by hairline borders rather than shadows. Type is the system font at small, dense sizes. Apart from the two voices, colour appears only as state: a status dot on a chip, a red error, a green success. The page is one self-contained file with no web fonts, images or icon sets. Its character comes from restraint and consistency, not ornament.

Light and dark themes are first-class. Dark mode is not an inversion: it is a separately tuned set of near-black stone surfaces in which both voices are re-tuned (a brighter blue, a deeper orange) to keep their contrast and balance.
keyCharacteristics: Two voice colours (coder blue, reviewer orange) on warm neutral stone.
Flat surfaces, 1px translucent hairlines, no resting shadows.
System font only, 11–26px, with tabular numerals for data.
Colour as state: dot-chips carry status, the text stays ink.
Dense, scannable, desktop-first, collapsing gracefully at 640px.

rules.name: The Voice Ownership Rule
rules.body: Blue means the coder and orange means the reviewer, and nothing else. Actions use the ink `--action` token; data that belongs to neither agent (such as rounds per loop) is drawn in Muted.

rules.name: The Dot, Not the Fill Rule
rules.body: Status colour is carried by a small dot or a short run of text, never by a filled background. Chip text stays ink.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every numeric column and chart tick uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` and is right-aligned in tables.

rules.name: The No Web Fonts Rule
rules.body: The file is self-contained and must work from `file://`. Never load a font; use system stacks only.

rules.name: The Hairline, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with a 1px translucent border and a change in tone. Do not add shadows to cards, tiles or controls.

dos: Do keep blue for the coder and orange for the reviewer in every chart, legend and paired view.
Do define every colour as a token on `:root`, with dark values under `prefers-color-scheme: dark` (guarded by `:not([data-theme="light"])`) and again under `[data-theme="dark"]`.
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairlines and a change in tone.
Do carry status as a dot in a pill chip, with the text left in ink.
Do set file-sourced strings (IDs, paths, commands) in the monospace stack.
Do use tabular numerals for every number.
Do use the ink `--action` token for links, current navigation, primary buttons and focus.
donts: Don't use coder blue or reviewer orange for actions, statuses or data that belongs to neither agent.
Don't load web fonts, icon fonts, images or any external resource.
Don't add shadows to cards, tiles or controls; the tooltip is the only lifted element.
Don't fill large areas with status colours.
Don't introduce new saturated hues beyond the two voices and four statuses.
